research.title: Frontend i18n That Does Not Turn Into Technical Debt
research.whyTrending: Localization reaches routing, bundle splitting, deployment and content ownership, and badly designed setups compound with every feature. Genuine first-hand angle: this blog shipped a Polish locale, then had to redirect all of it away because the translations became unmaintainable.

content.finalTitle: Frontend i18n Debt: I Shipped 126 Translations, Then Redirected Them Away
